curated-dafont-pixel-operator-work-sans: Chunky terminal nostalgia up top, with Pixel Operator's fixed-width blocks. Work Sans underneath has open c tips and a high mean line, so it feels current enough for, say, settings toggles.
curated-gf-edu-vic-wa-nt-hand-pre-gf-tsu: Loose, crayon-soft handwriting meets tidy roundness. Edu VIC WA NT Hand Pre earns its keep when big and short, while Tsukimi Rounded keeps its rims matched to its stems and isn't meant for long paragraphs.
curated-gf-jersey-10-charted-gf-noto-nas: Jersey 10 Charted hits hard and tight. Noto Nastaliq Urdu, a classic serif, sits low and compact across a longer stretch, with mild stress in its rounds, though it is better for brief copy.
curated-gf-kapakana-gf-spectral-sc: Relaxed pen strokes, a little bookish polish. Kapakana is best at its crowded, almost-merging letter pairs and low x-height, while Spectral SC does its best work with sturdy hairlines and wide, open rounds.
